exhibitors.name: 12 Volt Power/Comet Antenna
exhibitors.description: 12 Volt Power / Comet Antenna is a Proud North America supplier of Comet Antenna’s, DAIWA watt-meters, ANYTONE Radio’s, genuine Anderson Powerpoles, Red/Black hook-up wire and more!

exhibitors.name: ABR Industries
exhibitors.description: ABR Industries is a full-service cable assembly and bulk cable facility.  Our products are made to detailed specifications that ensure tight tolerances and the highest quality.  We service a variety of RF, Microwave, Government, Military, Municipal, and Consumer markets.

exhibitors.name: AI6YM Radio
exhibitors.description: AI6YM Radio

exhibitors.name: ARRL
exhibitors.description: The ARRL (American Radio Relay League) is the national association for amateur radio in the United States. Founded in 1914, it acts as a non-profit organization representing the interests of ham radio operators through advocacy, education, and publications, with its headquarters located in Newington, Connecticut.

exhibitors.name: ARRL 6th District QSL Bureau
exhibitors.description: The Sixth District Incoming QSL Bureau is staffed by over two dozen dedicated California radio amateurs who volunteer their time to distribute DX QSL cards to you. Many have donated their time for more than a decade!

exhibitors.name: Bay Area Mesh
exhibitors.description: The Bay Area Mesh (BAM) provides wireless data connectivity and services using Amateur Radio frequencies, and devices running AREDN software.  It is a federated network built by and for ham radio operators, and it covers the San Francisco Bay Area and surrounding regions in northern California.

exhibitors.name: Bioenno Power
exhibitors.description: At Bioenno Tech, LLC, doing business as Bioenno Power, we're based in the innovation hub of Southern California. Our primary mission is to provide the commercial market with advanced power solutions centered around Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) technology, a cutting-edge Lithium-ion power unit. LiFePO4 batteries, known for their superior performance, offer significant improvements over traditional Lead Acid and other Lithium-based batteries. These improvements include a cycle life of over 2000 cycles, significantly higher energy density of 90-160Wh/kg, and operational temperature ranges from -20 to 75℃, showcasing their robustness and reliability.

exhibitors.name: Buddipole
exhibitors.description: Buddipole, Inc. is an American manufacturer based in Heber City, Utah, that specializes in portable, modular antenna systems for amateur radio operators, emergency communicators, and field hobbyists. Their flagship product, the Buddipole, is a versatile, adjustable dipole antenna designed to pack down compactly into a small carrying case.

exhibitors.name: California Historical Radio Society
exhibitors.description: Radio has been a part of most Americans’ lives for more than 100 years. From the earliest experiments with electrical sparks to transmit signals, to the smart phones of today, radio is the cornerstone of all forms of modern wireless communications. Yet few people today know much about the history of this vital technology, much less the pioneers -visionaries like Marconi, De Forest, Charles “Doc” Herrold and David Sarnoff – the men who invented and nurtured radio. The California Historical Radio Society (CHRS) strives to keep this important history alive by creating an environment conducive to sparking interest in radio, in young and old alike. We are filling the information gap between “wireless” in 1899 & “wireless” more than 100 years later.

exhibitors.name: Compudigital
exhibitors.description: Compudigital is a Research and Development company specializing in 3D Video Fly Around Tours and Pro

exhibitors.name: DATV
exhibitors.description: Digital Amateur TV (DATV) is a non-commercial hobby where licensed radio operators transmit live digital video and audio over radio waves. Using modified consumer broadcast standards like DVB-T or DVB-S, operators achieve clear color pictures and sound within allocated amateur radio frequency bands.

exhibitors.name: Elecraft
exhibitors.description:
Founded in 1998, Elecraft offers full-featured transceivers and accessories both as factory-assembled and easy-to-build kits.  

Our design philosophy was clear from the beginning: Our radios would offer both high performance and portability. These two goals have spawned eight complete transceiver product lines. 

All Elecraft products are assembled at our headquarters in Watsonville, California, on the western slope of the Santa Cruz mountains.

exhibitors.name: FlexRadio
exhibitors.description: FlexRadio is a pioneering US company founded in 2003 by Gerald Youngblood that revolutionized amateur and commercial high-frequency radio. They specialize in software-defined radios (SDRs), replacing traditional knobs and dials with digital signal processing and computer software control.

exhibitors.name: FreeDV
exhibitors.description: FreeDV is a suite of digital voice modes for HF radio. Our flagship mode is the Radio Autoencoder (RADE). You can run RADE using a free GUI application for Windows, Linux and macOS that allows any SSB radio to be used for high quality digital voice.

exhibitors.name: Geochron
exhibitors.description:
Since 1964, Geochron has revealed Earth in motion—through legendary mechanical world clocks and evolving 4K digital displays showing real-time sunlight, time zones, and global data.

The only place in the world where Geochrons are built (new or restored) is a small clock shop in Colorado Springs, USA where we wrench away on this beautiful mechanical timepiece. Geochron Digital is developed and supported out of the Pacific Northwest in a humble collection of home offices and a fulfillment warehouse. This is a micro-business!

exhibitors.name: Halibut Electronics
exhibitors.description: Halibut Electronics is a small, one person business on the Central Coast area of California. That one person is Mark Smith, aka Smitty, N6MTS.

exhibitors.name: Ham
exhibitors.description: Building at the intersection of medicine, technology, and human health, where the greatest returns come from compounding health, wealth, and meaning with equal discipline.

exhibitors.name: Handcrafted by Debi
exhibitors.description: Handmade one of a kind purses, book covers, totes bags, bowl cozy, and key wristlets, doggie poop bag holders, and jewelry.

exhibitors.name: HipHam Shirts
exhibitors.description:
HIP HAM SHIRTS....your source of original Hip Ham T-shirt designs. Color, color and more color variety both in shirts & in printing, quality in house screen printing, and best of all, original HIP HAM designs. We also offer all of our shirts up to size 5X. I have been designing ham shirts since 2006 and I have endeavored to add new exciting designs every year since. 

All shirts are screen printed (unless noted as a transfer) in the US on 100% cotton T shirts.

exhibitors.name: HRO
exhibitors.description:
In 1971, a California Highway Patrol officer and veteran of the Navy signal corps, who happened to be a ham, came into possession of a little radio emporium on a wooden train platform in Burlingame, CA. Bob Ferrero (Bob), who was then K6AHV and later became W6RJ, was a dedicated California Highway Patrolman. He loved ham radio and was determined to make a go of starting a business selling amateur radio products.

Today, HRO is a family owned business with multiple sales locations throughout the United States which include a formidable presence on the Internet, making it the largest Ham Radio dealership in the world.

exhibitors.name: Impulse Electronics
exhibitors.description:
Impulse Electronics was founded in 2003 as a supplier of power related materials for emergency communications such as Anderson Powerpole connectors and red/black power cable. 

We have grown by adding related items like AGM batteries and chargers; battery cases with RIGrunner powerpole distribution and chargers in one handy package; coax cable and connectors; various power cables (stock and custom); related tools; power terminals and some Powerwerx items, hand held radios, both Amateur and Commercial and Diamond Antennas and power related West Mountain Radio products. Also a line of portable power sources in various configurations to meet your every emergency and portable need. The DC-12 MINI series has become very popular.

exhibitors.name: Lido Radio Products
exhibitors.description: Lido Radio Products makes no holes mounting solutions for Amateur Radio, Tablets and Smart-Phones

exhibitors.name: Livermore Amateur Radio Klub
exhibitors.description: The Livermore Amateur Radio Klub (LARK) was incorporated on July 30, 1959,  as a nonprofit association of persons commonly interested in amateur radio. LARK serves the communities of Livermore, Pleasanton, and Dublin California, and the surrounding Tri-Valley area. LARK is also affiliated with the American Radio Relay League (ARRL).

exhibitors.name: Long Island CW Club
exhibitors.description: LICW offers a structured progression of CW classes spanning Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced levels. Each level focuses on specific skills and milestones along what we call the Path to Morse Code Fluency.

exhibitors.name: MDARC
exhibitors.description:
The Mount Diablo Amateur Radio Club (MDARC) was founded on January 9, 1947. Today it has a membership of over 300 dedicated hams and is one of the largest amateur radio clubs in California. MDARC's purpose is to encourage innovation in amateur radio, provide public service and educational opportunities, foster good will within our community, and have fun in the process.

MDARC provides a wide variety of programs and activities for its members. These include hosting and staffing PACIFICON (ARRL Pacific Division convention) each October, bringing in great speakers and offering ham radio classes to the public.  Our Field Day event, holiday party, and radio equipment auction are all enjoyable events!

exhibitors.name: NARCC
exhibitors.description:
The Northern Amateur Relay Council of California, Inc. (NARCC) is the Amateur Radio coordinating organization for the 10 meter band and higher in Northern California.
In cooperation with the FCC, ARRL, and the support of the hams in northern California, NARCC performs the repeater coordination function for the region. NARCC's region extends from California's coast to the Nevada border and from Tehachapi in the south to the Oregon border in the north.

exhibitors.name: Oakland Radio Communication Association
exhibitors.description: The Oakland Radio Communication Association (ORCA) is a non-profit amateur ham radio club serving Oakland, California, and surrounding East Bay cities. Founded in 1998 and affiliated with the American Radio Relay League (ARRL), ORCA focuses on advancing public service, education, and technology through radio operations, with a major emphasis on emergency communication preparedness.

exhibitors.name: Parachute Mobile
exhibitors.description:
Ham radio operators Mark Meltzer, AF6IM, and Michael Gregg, KF6WRW, were chatting on a repeater in 2008 and learned that they shared skydiving as a second hobby. They talked further about combining the two hobbies and the Parachute Mobile Project was born.

We operate amateur (ham) radio gear while skydiving. Radio jumps are usually HAHO types (high altitude high opening) to give maximum hang time for radio communications. The jumpers are supported by a team of experienced hams, one team at the drop zone and the other at mission control which is usually sited on a mountain peak overlooking the drop zone. Our jumps, or missions, as we refer to them, are great opportunities to make a contact and receive a special QSL card.

exhibitors.name: Park Lane Jewelry
exhibitors.description: Park Lane Jewelry, founded in 1955, is the leading direct sales jewelry company in the world. Family-owned, debt-free, and built on a legacy of integrity, generosity, and sparkle. For more than 70 years, we’ve created fashion-forward, high-quality jewelry and a business opportunity that empowers people to design a life they love.

exhibitors.name: QCWA - Mt Diablo Chapter 228
exhibitors.description: The Quarter Century Wireless Association was founded in 1947 to provide an organization for the pioneers of the hobby to gather.   QCWA promotes friendship and cooperation among Amateur Radio operators who were licensed at least a quarter century ago, and are licensed today.

exhibitors.name: RemoteTx
exhibitors.description: RemoteTx gives you remote control of your station in a web browser on a PC, Mac, iPhone or Andriod. Extremely easy and fast to set up.

exhibitors.name: SF-Hab
exhibitors.description: A community interested in amateur radio and ballooning of all forms. We fly balloons when weather permits, flying our own as well as other’s experimental payloads. Please join us!

exhibitors.name: SF-SKYWARN
exhibitors.description: We are an all-volunteer organization of trained weather spotters. SF Bay Area SKYWARN is a separate entity from the National Weather Service, and in no way represents the National Weather Service, its staff, products, or services.

exhibitors.name: Springboard
exhibitors.description: Springboard

exhibitors.name: UNI-T
exhibitors.description: Uni-Trend Technology (China) Co., Ltd. is one of the well-known test and measurement solutions provider in Asia. Uni-Trend is an ISO9001 and ISO14001 certified company, with T&M products meeting certifications including CE, ETL, UL, GS, etc

exhibitors.name: USS Hornet Amateur Radio Club
exhibitors.description: The current USS Hornet Amateur Radio Club was formed in July of 2002. The club's goal is to become the 'The Voice of the Hornet'. The ships original Navy Call sign was NBGC. In honor of the original call the Hornet Amateur Radio club operates with a call sign of NB6GC. The club's purpose is to promote interest in Amateur Radio and the USS Hornet Museum Ship for the community, its past crew members and club members. Many club members also serve the Museum Ship's staff and assist in preservation of the Hornet.

exhibitors.name: Western Case
exhibitors.description: For over 45 years, Western Case, Inc. has been one of the leading custom blow molding manufacturers of blow molded solutions and plastic carrying cases in the U.S. From our Southern California-based manufacturing facility, Western Case has produced millions of blow molded cases and custom blow molded products, servicing customers with solutions in the U.S., Mexico, Canada, Europe, the Middle East and Asia. Our broad experience in the engineering and manufacture of blow molded plastic carrying cases and custom blow molded products will be an asset to you at any stage of your project.

exhibitors.name: Wired Communications
exhibitors.description: We have been Electronics Service Technicians for over 30 years. Roger started his own TV Repair Shop in 1964, Then, on to start a mail-order computer supply house in Califonia from the late 1980’s which was sold in 2001. Kim went to work at Pacific Bell right after high school in the mid-70’s, She then started Wired Communications in 1984. The combined forces of Kim & Roger Deane has created Wired Communications, your online cable and electronic accessory source. Specialist in 12V LED Lighting, Ham or Amateur Radio, Home Theater, HDTV Systems, Computer Network Wiring and Audio-Video goods. Selling on eBay as user I.D. rogerdeane, here on this website, and at various "meets" around the Country. You may contact me directly at roger@wiredco.com for any questions, help, kudos, or complaints. I'd love to hear from you!

exhibitors.name: Yaesu
exhibitors.description: Yaesu is a major Japanese brand of amateur, marine, and aviation radio communications equipment. Founded in Tokyo in 1959 by amateur radio operator Sako Hasegawa, the company is internationally recognized for manufacturing high-performance transceivers, handheld radios, and receivers used by ham radio operators worldwide.

exhibitors.name: Young Ladies Radio League
exhibitors.description: The YLRL was established in 1939.  82 years after that fateful question of “are there any YLs out there?” the answer is a resounding yes – the YLs are out there and active! Ethel Smith started an organization that has outlasted its founding mothers, but is still going strong with members all over the world. Though none of the original 12 founding mothers are longer with us, there is at least one member who has earned 65 years of continuous membership and another with 64. A handful of members have 50-55 years of continuous membership as well.

exhibitors.name: Zero Retries
exhibitors.description: Zero Retries is an independent newsletter promoting technological innovation in and adjacent to Amateur Radio, and Amateur Radio as (literally) a license to experiment with and learn about radio technology. Radios are computers - with antennas! Now in its fifth year of publication, with [3500]+ subscribers.
